subject: Moon and Back Bookstore Profile
overview: The Medford Bytes podcast interviewed Brian Smith, co-owner of West Medford's Moon and Back Bookstore, to discuss the store's rapid opening, its inclusive community mission, and upcoming local events.

items.title: Podcast Introduction
items.summary: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan introduced the episode and outlined the podcast's mission to highlight Medford issues and local businesses.

items.title: Interview with Brian Smith on Local Favorites
items.summary: Brian Smith introduced himself as a middle school history teacher and co-owner of the bookstore before sharing his favorite local food spots, Lola's Coffee and 4 Pizza.

items.title: Origin of Moon and Back Bookstore
items.summary: Smith recounted how a family conversation prompted his wife, Michelle, to plan the bookstore, which opened in West Medford within six months of finding the location.

items.title: Bookstore Mission and Inclusivity
items.summary: Smith described the bookstore's focus on diverse representation, eco-friendly inventory, themed display shelves, and maintaining a welcoming environment specifically designed for children.

items.title: Community Engagement and Local Authors
items.summary: Smith highlighted events featuring local authors, such as Kat Bacardi, and discussed a community table featuring book recommendations curated by local kids.

items.title: Future Events and Initiatives
items.summary: Smith detailed an upcoming July "Where's Waldo" search partnering with 25 local businesses and shared a long-term goal of hosting a maker fair for neighborhood children.

items.title: Podcast Outro
items.summary: Balocca closed the episode with production credits and information on how listeners can provide feedback.
